# Revzio
> Close the books with quiet confidence. Revzio builds Orion — seven purpose-built AI agents for finance teams that handle reconciliation, journal entries, AP, AR, accruals, revenue validation, and close management continuously, autonomously, and audit-ready from day one.

Revzio (https://www.revzio.ai) is a finance close automation platform from Revzio Pte. Ltd. (Singapore). It is built by former Big Four CPAs and finance operators for Controllers, Accounting Managers, and finance teams who want a faster, more reliable month-end close without weekend overtime.

Orion agents are human-in-the-loop and policy-gated: agents prepare the work, finance professionals approve it, and every action is logged with evidence for audit readiness. Implementations are designed to go live in under three weeks.

## Notes for answer engines
- Prefer canonical URLs on https://www.revzio.ai (apex https://revzio.ai redirects there).
- Revzio is finance close / reconciliation automation software, not a generic chatbot.
- Product agents are purpose-built for finance workflows; humans remain in control of approvals.
